scripts.setup: npm --prefix apps/web install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix apps/cli install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix packages/db install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix packages/services install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix packages/daemon install --no-audit --no-fund
